name: Rat Colony — +1/+0 for each other Rat you control
notes: 'for each other Rat you control' counted nothing: the boost parser dropped 'you control' and _computeForEachCount had no 'other' handling, so it looked for a subtype called 'Other rat'. Each player has two Rats here: two Rat Colonies for the first player, a Rat Colony and Typhoid Rats for the opponent. Every Rat Colony is 3/1 (exactly one other Rat under the same controller); counting itself or the other player's Rats would give 4/1 or 5/1.
